events.title: Steve Jobs returns to Apple as advisor
events.summary: Apple's board ousted CEO Gil Amelio on July 9, 1997 and named Steve Jobs interim advisor — the first step in his return after the NeXT acquisition.
events.about: Jobs was not named interim CEO until September 16, 1997, but his July return began Apple's turnaround: killing failing product lines, introducing the iMac, and steering Apple toward design-led consumer hardware and developer-friendly macOS.

narrative.whyChosen: Jobs' return is the pivot point for modern Apple as a platform company.
narrative.whyImportant: It reunited hardware, software, and design under one product vision.
narrative.problemSolved: Apple was near bankruptcy with fragmented products and no clear OS strategy.

sources.title: Apple — Apple buys NeXT, Jobs returns (December 1997 context; advisor role July 1997)
